purpose: Fresh independent OpenAI Compose reserve A, October 2. Freeze and commit before any production export or generation.

semanticCriteria.gate: At least 19 of 20 useful review-ready drafts; zero critical changes to meaning, recipients, exact words, restrictions, uncertainty, privacy or writing-direction separation. A rejected draft is not useful.
semanticCriteria.critical: Changed or invented operative facts, dropped recipient or condition, changed exact literal, a consumed writer instruction in the message, an invented task, disclosed excluded reason or claimed execution.
semanticCriteria.minor: Faithful stylistic paraphrase, capitalization outside exact text, punctuation or list formatting that retains all operative meaning.
semanticCriteria.review: Grade the first model outputs using frozen per-case criteria and production output guards. Preserve failures; do not tune or rerun before grading.

cases.spoken: Good morning, did you receive my note? Make this professional.
cases.exampleDraft: Good morning, have you received my note?
cases.completionCriteria: Preserve greeting and question; consume professional direction.

cases.spoken: Tell Elena the slides are ready and she can review them after lunch. Keep it casual.
cases.exampleDraft: Elena, the slides are ready for you to review after lunch.
cases.completionCriteria: Elena, slides ready, permissive timing after lunch; casual.

cases.spoken: Tell Ben I expect to finish the draft this evening unless the supplier sends more changes.
cases.exampleDraft: Ben, I expect to finish the draft this evening unless the supplier sends more changes.
cases.completionCriteria: Preserve tentative expectation and supplier condition, not a firm promise.

cases.spoken: Tell Asha the review is on Wednesday. Actually, it is on Thursday. Please ask whether that works.
cases.exampleDraft: Asha, the review is on Thursday. Does that work for you?
cases.completionCriteria: Only Thursday; Asha; ask availability.

cases.spoken: Write a note to Finn with the exact words "Hold the release until Friday".
cases.exampleDraft: Finn, Hold the release until Friday.
cases.completionCriteria: Finn and complete exact quoted body; no instruction to use the words.

cases.spoken: The fee is $45 per account each quarter, not per month.
cases.exampleDraft: The fee is $45 per account each quarter, not per month.
cases.completionCriteria: Keep amount, account unit, quarter period and negative month contrast.

cases.spoken: Tell Greta I cannot help this weekend because I have a family commitment. Leave out the reason.
cases.exampleDraft: Greta, I cannot help this weekend.
cases.completionCriteria: Recipient, decline and weekend; no family reason or writer direction.

cases.spoken: Ask Nadia to shorten the opening section but keep every example in the appendix.
cases.exampleDraft: Nadia, please shorten the opening section, but keep every example in the appendix.
cases.completionCriteria: Preserve recipient editing instructions and every-example restriction.

cases.spoken: Tell Victor I appreciate his patience while we review the application. Make it warm.
cases.exampleDraft: Victor, I really appreciate your patience while we review the application.
cases.completionCriteria: Victor, appreciation, ongoing review; no approval implied.

cases.spoken: Tell Hana I cannot finish the outline today, but I can send the first section tomorrow morning. Make this concise.
cases.exampleDraft: Hana, I cannot finish the outline today, but I can send the first section tomorrow morning.
cases.completionCriteria: Keep both actions, negative finish boundary, today and tomorrow morning.

cases.spoken: Write three bullets: the adapter is installed; the sync has not finished; the rollout date is tentative.
cases.exampleDraft:
- The adapter is installed.
- The sync has not finished.
- The rollout date is tentative.
cases.completionCriteria: Exactly three distinct bullets; preserve negative and tentative status.

cases.spoken: Ask Codex to review `lib/Session.swift` and `lib/Store.swift`. Do not change code or commit anything.
cases.exampleDraft: Review lib/Session.swift and lib/Store.swift. Do not change code or commit anything.
cases.completionCriteria: Direct prompt, exact paths, both negative action restrictions.

cases.spoken: Ask Claude to explain why `loadRecord` returns nil for an empty index. Do not implement a fix.
cases.exampleDraft: Explain why loadRecord returns nil for an empty index. Do not implement a fix.
cases.completionCriteria: Direct explanation task, identifier, nil, empty-index condition, no implementation.

cases.spoken: I am not certain, but the last retry may have reused the old token. Write this as a reply in Codex.
cases.exampleDraft: I am not certain, but the last retry may have reused the old token.
cases.completionCriteria: Keep uncertainty and statement; no invented coding task.

cases.spoken: Ask Pavel if 9:30 AM PT on Monday works, or whether Tuesday would be better.
cases.exampleDraft: Pavel, does 9:30 AM PT on Monday work, or would Tuesday be better?
cases.completionCriteria: Recipient, exact time and timezone, two weekday alternatives, question.

cases.spoken: Tell Daria request REQ-73 is queued, but it has not been approved or rejected.
cases.exampleDraft: Daria, request REQ-73 is queued and has not been approved or rejected.
cases.completionCriteria: Exact identifier, queued status, both negative decision states.

cases.spoken: Tell Iris the transfer is complete. Sorry, the upload is complete; the transfer is still pending.
cases.exampleDraft: Iris, the upload is complete; the transfer is still pending.
cases.completionCriteria: Corrected subject, completed upload, pending transfer and recipient.

cases.spoken: Ask Codex to run the parser tests with literal flag dry run end literal for literal verbatim tests/ParserTests.swift end literal. Do not publish the results.
cases.exampleDraft: Run the parser tests with --dry-run for tests/ParserTests.swift. Do not publish the results.
cases.completionCriteria: Direct task, exact --dry-run and path, no publication, no claimed execution.

cases.spoken: Tell Ken I can review one proposal this week, but I cannot take on the entire project. Make this polite.
cases.exampleDraft: Ken, I can review one proposal this week, but I cannot take on the entire project.
cases.completionCriteria: Recipient, one-proposal capacity, this week, project boundary.

cases.spoken: I think the totals exclude shipping, but I am not sure. Could you confirm before we send the estimate? Write this professionally.
cases.exampleDraft: I believe the totals exclude shipping, but I am not certain. Could you confirm before we send the estimate?
cases.completionCriteria: Preserve uncertainty, shipping exclusion, confirmation question and before-send condition.
